niche: connected TV and streaming advertising agency
prompt_text: What is the best connected TV advertising agency?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” connected TV (CTV) advertising agency — the right choice depends on your goals, budget, target markets, creative needs, and whether you want programmatic scale or a boutique/managed approach. That said, here are well-regarded options organized by type, with what they’re best for and who they’re a good fit for.

Large/global media groups (full-service, scale)
- GroupM (Wavemaker, Mindshare, EssenceMediacom) — strong programmatic reach, cross-channel planning, good for global brands and big budgets.  
- Omnicom Media Group (OMD, PHD) — creative + media integration, strong publisher relationships.  
- Publicis Media (Starcom, Zenith) — data-driven planning and measurement at scale.  
- Dentsu (Carat, iProspect) and IPG Mediabrands (Initiative, UM) — similar strengths for large advertisers.

When to pick: you need global coverage, integrated TV+digital planning, and a full-service partner.

Programmatic- and data-focused specialists
- The Trade Desk — leading DSP for programmatic CTV buying (often used by agencies and brands directly).  
- Simulmedia — specializes in TV/CTV planning and deterministic reach for linear/streaming crossover.  
- Amobee — offers cross-screen programmatic and analytics.  
- Microsoft Advertising / Xandr (brand folded into Microsoft) — programmatic TV and premium inventory access.

When to pick: you want precision programmatic buying, custom audience targeting, or in-house buying with a tech partner.

Publisher/platform partners (managed services & premium inventory)
- Roku Advertising, Hulu, Samsung Ads, Vizio/Inscape — provide premium inventory and managed-services buying and measurement.  
- Roku/Hulu best if you want guaranteed premium CTV placements and audience data.

When to pick: you want premium placements, direct publisher deals, or simpler managed campaigns.

Boutique/specialist CTV agencies and creative partners
- Agencies such as Simulmedia (also does managed buying), Innovid (creative personalization & measurement), and independent CTV shops or creative boutiques that focus on storytelling for streaming platforms.

When to pick: you need specialized CTV creative, dynamic/ad-personalized creative, or a nimble partner for experimentation.

How to choose (quick checklist)
- Campaign goal: brand reach vs direct-response vs attribution.  
- Inventory access: programmatic vs publisher-managed vs guaranteed buys.  
- Measurement: do they offer MRC-compliant viewability, attribution to conversions, or ACR-panel measurement?  
- Creative capabilities: can they produce and adapt CTV creative and do dynamic/ad personalization?  
- Transparency and fees: ask about data usage, third-party measurement, and platform fees.  
- Case studies & references: vertical experience and proof of performance.

If you want, tell me:
- Your budget range, geographic market(s), type of campaign (brand vs performance), and whether you already have creative in CTV specs — and I’ll recommend 2–3 agencies/platforms that fit your needs and why.
